name: Wulfgar of Icewind Dale
clause: If a creature you control attacking causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.

needs.proposedSignature: Amount.count gains 'opponents-attacked-this-combat'; Keyword gains 'melee'; KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS gains 'melee': 'whenever ~ attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each opponent you attacked this combat'.
needs.semantics: The count is the number of opponents the ability's controller attacked this combat, so melee becomes { on: 'attacks', self: true } -> { op: 'pump', target: 'self', power: { count: 'opponents-attacked-this-combat' }, toughness: the same, duration: 'eot' }. As a Keyword it can also be granted by an anthem ('Other creatures you control have melee.').

needs.proposedSignature: TriggerEvent 'cast' gains self: true ('When you cast this spell'); trigger-twice.event gains 'attacks'; a new event { on: 'untap-step'; whose: 'your' | 'each' | 'opponent' }.
needs.semantics: 'When you cast this spell, ...' (Emrakul) cannot be written because `cast` takes a Filter that cannot mean 'this spell'; Wulfgar needs trigger doubling for attack triggers; Prop Room needs 'during each other player's untap step'.
needs.clause: When you cast ~, gain control of all creatures target player controls.
